rationale.DoS: Consolidates Denial of Service attack tools (Hulk, GoldenEye, Slowloris, Slowhttptest) into a cohesive DoS category.
rationale.BruteForce: Combines network service credential guessing attacks (FTP-Patator and SSH-Patator).
rationale.WebAttack: Aggregates application-layer attacks (SQL Injection, Cross-Site Scripting, and Web Brute Force).
rationale.Botnet: Maps the ARES Bot traffic into a recognized industry threat category.
rationale.BENIGN: Retains clean, non-malicious network activity as the negative class.
rationale.DDoS: Preserves volumetric distributed denial of service (LOIC) as a distinct threat class.
rationale.PortScan: Preserves network reconnaissance and port scanning as a distinct threat class.
rationale.Infiltration: Preserves lateral movement and exploit payloads as a distinct threat class.
rationale.Heartbleed: Preserves the OpenSSL memory leakage exploit as an acute vulnerability class.
